title: Final Wave Function
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the final wave function psi(x,t) as given in the reference solution.

title: Probability Density
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly express the limiting value of |psi(x,t)|^2 as given in the reference solution.

title: Fourier Transform Definition
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly define the Fourier transform of the initial wave function, varphi(k).

title: Conservation of Probability
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain the conservation of total probability in the context of the wave function's evolution.

title: Limiting Behavior Interpretation
description: Important Criteria: The student must provide a plausible physical interpretation of the limiting behavior of |psi(x,t)|^2 as t approaches infinity.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign errors in the expressions for the wave function and its probability density.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the derivation.
